hint: A hand 寸 pointing the way to someplace 巳

mnemonic: A mouth 口 and ten 十: ten leaves, ten pages.
mnemonic_ja: 口に十——十枚の「葉」。

mnemonic: A hand 扌 swinging an axe 斤 breaks and folds.
mnemonic_ja: 手扌で斤(斧)を振り折る——「折る」。
hint: A hand 扌 wielding an axe 斤

mnemonic: A person 者 piling earth 土 blocks the road.
mnemonic_ja: 者が土を積んでふさぐ——「ふさぐ」。

mnemonic: The fruit of a tree 木 sold at the market 市 is persimmon.
mnemonic_ja: 市で売る木の実——「柿」。

mnemonic: Food 饣 folded crosswise 交 is a dumpling.
mnemonic_ja: 食饣を交(交差)に包む——「餃子」。

mnemonic: Earth 土 standing 立 in a heap is garbage.
mnemonic_ja: 土が立つように積まれる——「ごみ(垃圾)」。

mnemonic: Earth 土 reaching 及 the top of the heap is garbage.
mnemonic_ja: 土が及(届く)ほど積まれる——「ごみ(垃圾)」。

mnemonic: Wood 木 with a passage 甬 for water is a bucket.
mnemonic_ja: 木に甬(通り道)——「桶」。

mnemonic: Earth 土 shaped on the new moon 朔 is molded.
mnemonic_ja: 朔(新月)に土を形作る——「形作る」。

mnemonic: Clothing 衣 that takes the place 代 of hands is a bag.
mnemonic_ja: 衣が代わりに持つ——「袋」。

mnemonic: Sheep 羊 fed by a kneeling person 儿 are raised.
mnemonic_ja: 羊を儿(人)が育てる——「養う」。

mnemonic: A metal 钅 pin 十 is a needle.
mnemonic_ja: 金钅の十字の針——「針」。
hint: A metal 钅 pin 十

mnemonic: Water 氵 showing 显 on the surface is wet.
mnemonic_ja: 水氵が显(現れる)——「湿った」。

mnemonic: Water 氵 in a leap 闰 month is extra moisture.
mnemonic_ja: 闰(余分)の水氵——「潤う」。

mnemonic: Two feathers side by side are feathers.
mnemonic_ja: 二枚の羽根が並ぶ——「羽」。

mnemonic: Ice 冫 at the capital 京 is cool.
mnemonic_ja: 京に冫(氷)——「涼しい」。

mnemonic: A mouth 口 chirping like a bird 隹 is selling.
mnemonic_ja: 隹(鳥)のように口で売り込む——「売る」。
hint: A street vendor talks 口 incessantly, like a bird 隹

mnemonic: Things changed 化 into money 贝 are goods.
mnemonic_ja: 化けて贝(お金)になる——「商品」。

mnemonic: Water 氵 flowing as straight as a worker's 工 line is a river.
mnemonic_ja: 水氵が工(まっすぐ)流れる——「川」。

mnemonic: Under a roof 宀, huddled in straw on ice, one is cold.
mnemonic_ja: 宀の下で藁にくるまり氷に震える——「寒い」。

mnemonic: A stroke 丿 on cloth 巾 is a silk bill: money.
mnemonic_ja: 巾(布)に丿と記す——「貨幣」。

mnemonic: Rice 米 that is moreover 且 unpolished is coarse.
mnemonic_ja: 米が且(さらに)粗い——「粗い」「太い」。

mnemonic: Given 予 a page 页 beforehand is in advance.
mnemonic_ja: 予(あらかじめ)页を渡す——「あらかじめ」。

mnemonic: A knife 刂 cutting into a residence 居 is dramatic.
mnemonic_ja: 居に刂(刀)が切り込む——「劇」。

mnemonic: Earth 土 filling truly 真 full fills it in.
mnemonic_ja: 土を真(いっぱい)に——「記入する」。

mnemonic: The sun 日 beating down on a person 者 is summer heat.
mnemonic_ja: 日が者を照りつける——「暑さ」。
